svg.text: ESP32-C3 + 4× 74HC595 + 32× MOSFET | Row multiplexing, PWM via OE# blanking | VHEAT 5–12V
Within each row slot, OE# creates PWM for per-pixel intensity
SPI burst (32 bits): [COL_SR 16b] + [ROW_SR 16b] per row slot
→ latch both chains simultaneously → switch row in <5µs
J2 — 32-pin FPC (bottom edge, 0.5mm pitch) — 16 ROW + 16 COL
Bottom layer: VHEAT pour | Top layer: GND pour | 1.5mm row/col traces | M2.5 mounting ×4
